newsitem.title: USA: American Insured Mortgage sets Dec payout.
newsitem.headline: American Insured Mortgage sets Dec payout.

text.p: American Insured Investors LP - Series 86 declared on Friday a monthly distribution for December 1996 of $2.59 per unit.
The per unit distribution includes $0.07 of regular cash flow and a $2.52 return of capital and gain received from prepayment of the mortgages on Pembrook Apartments and Skyridge Club Apartments.
The distribution will be paid February 3, 1997 to holders of record December 31.
American Insured said that total distribution for the fouth quarter is $3.33 per unit.
